name: CC/SA MEETING - MARCH 5, 2019 - 7PM
agenda_text:
CC/SA MEETING - MARCH 5, 2019 - 7PM
CC/SA MEETING - MARCH 5, 2019 - 7PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, MARCH 05, 2019
07:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 1448
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3. ROLL CALL: MAYOR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM BISHOP, COUNCILMEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA
4. PRESENTATION:
4.1 Palmdale Animal Care Center representative will present a cute critter that is available for adoption from our local Animal Care Center.
4.2 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a Proclamation to a representative of North Valley Chapter of the American Red Cross proclaiming March as Red Cross Month in the City of Palmdale.
5. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S) and ORDINANCE(S):
Staff Recommendation: Waive full reading of the Resolution(s) and/or Ordinance(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.
6. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON 7.1 through 7.15 (CONSENT CALENDAR).
Staff Recommendation: Approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under this Consent Calendar by one vote.
7. CONSENT CALENDAR:
7.1 CC - Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale’s books as of January 31, 2019. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the City of Palmdale’s books.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.1
7.2 CC - Accept the Annual Report on Development Impact Fees and adopt findings to commit funds held in the Amargosa Drainage Fee Fund, Portal Ridge Drainage Fee Fund, Pearland Drainage Fee Fund, Littlerock Drainage Fee Fund, Fire Facilities Fee Fund, Sewer Upgrade Fee Fund, and the Park Development Fee Fund. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the Annual Report on Development Impact Fees.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.2
7.3 CC - Approve Change Order to increase FY 2018-2019 Purchase Order No. 20190115 with Consolidated Electrical Distributor for electrical supplies in an amount not to exceed $17,000 budgeted in Lighting Supplies Account No. 10135002-732634. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Approve Change Order to increase FY 2018-2019 Purchase Order No. 20190115 with Consolidated Electrical Distributor.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.3
7.4 CC - Approval of First Amendment to Agreement between the City of Palmdale and Antelope Valley Press, for printing of Palmdale: News, Activities and Entertainment magazine, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and all necessary documents, funded through account 10117002-722350, Agreement No. A-6310. (Staff Reference: Communications Manager Mlynar)
Staff Recommendation: Approval of First Amendment to Agreement between the City of Palmdale and Antelope Valley Press.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.4
7.5 CC – ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-020, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AMENDING THE CITY OF PALMDALE HUMAN RESOURCES RULES AND REGULATIONS. (Staff Reference: Human Resources Manager Nevarez)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-020.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.5
7.6 CC – ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-026, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AMENDING THE CITY’S CLASSIFICATION AND PAY PLAN FOR GENERAL POSITIONS. (Staff Reference: Human Resources Manager Nevarez)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-026.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.6
7.7 CC - Approve the purchase and additional budget for six (6) Public Safety Vehicles, new 2014 Ford Taurus Sedan(s), Purchase Order No. 20190574 with National Auto Fleet Group, through Sourcewell Cooperative Agreement #120716-NAF, in an amount not to exceed $139,993.50 and an additional amount of $20,000 for all accessories, funded through multiple accounts. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
Staff Recommendation: Approve the purchase and additional budget for six (6) Public Safety Vehicles, new 2014 Ford Taurus Sedan(s), Purchase Order No. 20190574 with National Auto Fleet Group.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.7
7.8 CC - Award of Project No. 743, Federal Project No. HSIPL-5378 (043), Upgrade Existing Un-signalized Crosswalks with Ladder Style Crosswalks and ADA Ramp Construction, to FS Contractors, Inc., in the amount of $355,113.75, funded through multiple accounts, Agreement No. A-6559. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Award of Project No. 743, Federal Project No. HSIPL-5378 (043) Upgrade Existing Un-signalized Crosswalks with Ladder Style Crosswalks and ADA Ramp Construction, to FS Contractors, Inc.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.8
7.9 CC - ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-021, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE RATIFYING THE CITY MANAGER ENTERING INTO SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT NO. 2 AGREEMENT NO. A-6079 (FODDRILL CONSTRUCTION CORP. TO PROVIDE ADDITIONAL STREETLIGHT INSPECTION SERVICES IN COORDINATION WITH CITY STAFF). (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-021.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.9
7.10 CC - ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-018, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING JOINT RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS OF THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF THE ANTELOPE VALLEY CEMETERY DISTRICT, THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES OF THE ANTELOPE VALLEY MOSQUITO AND VECTOR CONTROL DISTRICT, THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF COUNTY SANITATION DISTRICT NO. 20 OF LOS ANGELES COUNTY, THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF THE ANTELOPE VALLEY RESOURCE CONSERVATION DISTRICT, THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE, AND THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF THE ANTELOPE VALLEY-EAST KERN WATER AGENCY APPROVING AND ACCEPTING THE NEGOTIATED EXCHANGE OF PROPERTY TAX REVENUES RESULTING FROM ANNEXATION OF PROPERTY DESIGNATED AS ANNEXATION 40-152 (34-43), LOCAL AGENCY FORMATION COMMISSION DESIGNATION 2018-10, TO THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY WATERWORKS DISTRICT NO. 40, ANTELOPE VALLEY. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-018.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.10
7.11 CC - Approval of Final Map for Tract Map No. 54058-4 (Located at southwest corner of Avenue P-8 and 20th Street West) and authorize the City Clerk to execute City Clerk’s Statement, Special Assessments Statement, and Abandonment Note and authorize the Acting City Surveyor to execute the City Surveyor’s Statement and file the map with the County Recorder. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Approval of Final Map for Tract Map No. 54058-4.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.11
7.12 CC - Acceptance of Completed Capital Improvement Project, Project No. 748, the 2018 Arterial Overlay Program, with Granite Construction Inc., and authorize the Director of Public Works be authorized to file a Notice of Completion, Agreement No. A-6312. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: Acceptance of Completed Capital Improvement Project, Project No. 748, the 2018 Arterial Overlay Program, with Granite Construction Inc.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.12
7.13 CC - ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-027, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE ADOPTING A LIST OF PROJECTS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019-2020 PROPOSED TO BE FUNDED BY SB 1: THE ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2017. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)
Staff Recommendation: ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2019-027.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.13
7.14 SA - Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale's books as of January 31, 2019. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Accept the monthly report on investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.14
7.15 Approve the minutes from the previous meetings. (Staff Reference: City Clerk/Agency Secretary Smith)
* CC/SA – February 5, 2019 (7pm)
Staff Recommendation: Approve the minutes from the previous meetings.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 7.15
8. APPOINTMENT:
8.1 Nomination of a Director for appointment by The Palmdale Aerospace Academy (TPAA) Board of Directors to serve on The Palmdale Aerospace Academy Board of Directors for a term to expire on July 31, 2021. (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Nominate Ellen McIsaac as a Director for appointment by The Palmdale Aerospace Academy (TPAA) Board of Directors to serve on The Palmdale Aerospace Academy Board of Directors for a term to expire on July 31, 2021.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 8.1
9. NEW BUSINESS:
9.1 Approve the mid-year budget adjustments to the 2018-19 Fiscal Year budget. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Approve the mid-year budget adjustments to the 2018-19 Fiscal Year budget.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 9.1
9.2 Receive and file a report of the recommendations of the Cannabis Advisory Committee. (Staff Reference: Director of Administrative Services Ambrose)
Staff Recommendation: Receive and file a report of the recommendations of the Cannabis Advisory Committee.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 9.2
10. PUBLIC HEARING:
10.1 Public Hearing and Review of Proposed Ordinance No. 1522 for adoption (Staff Reference: City Attorney Ditzhazy)
Staff Recommendation: Receive public testimony and consider proposed Ordinance No. 1522.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 10.1
10.2 Public hearing to provide interested citizens with the opportunity to express their views concerning the use of Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) and HOME Investment Partnership Program (HOME) funds for Fiscal Year 2018-2019 in compliance with the City's Citizen Participation Plan and the implementing regulation 24 CFR 91.105. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings as listed in the staff report.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 10.2
10.3 Public Hearing and Review of Proposed Ordinance No. 1519 for adoption (Staff Reference: City Attorney Ditzhazy)
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Ordinance No. 1519.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 10.3
10.4 Public Hearing and Review of Proposed Ordinance No. 1520 for adoption (Staff Reference: City Attorney Ditzhazy)
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Ordinance No. 1520.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 10.4
11. SPECIAL REPORT:
11.1 Update by Antelope Valley Community College President Edward Knudson regarding the Antelope Valley Community College District's Palmdale Campus. (Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 11.1
12. NON-AGENDA ITEMS – PUBLIC COMMENTS:
13. INFORMATIONAL REPORT FROM MAYOR AND / OR COUNCILMEMBERS ON THEIR VARIOUS COMMITTEE MEMBERSHIPS AND MEETINGS ATTENDED AT PUBLIC EXPENSE.
13.1 VARIOUS COMMITTEE MEMBERSHIPS:
13.2 MEETINGS ATTENDED AT PUBLIC EXPENSE.
14. CITY COUNCIL REQUESTS FOR NEW AGENDA ITEMS.
15. CLOSED SESSION – PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
16. PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY of the following item(s) to be discussed in Closed Session:
16.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel and to receive direction from the City Council regarding the possible initiation of litigation by the City.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL--ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
Initiation of litigation pursuant to paragraph (4) of subdivision
(d) of Section 54956.9: Number of cases – One.
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is in the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case.
17. CLOSED SESSION.
18. ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
19. ADJOURNMENT.
